# Building a Battle Containerized Game with Maven+Guice+Battle*ee

This article describes how to create a command line game using Maven 3, Guice and Battle*ee. The game uses four principle concepts: Square, Partition, Board and Coin. Each coin has a fixed position on the board and a direction where it can move. The position is defined by the square number. The board gets divided in partitions which hold the coins. In this particular game the board is made of a four by four grid.

```java
Square north = square.north();
Square south = square.south();
Square west = square.west();
Square east = square.east
